layers.work: Die-cut embossed aluminum lid with PP-compatible heat-seal lacquer that seals airtight yet peels smoothly without shredding.

material_composition.why_this_material_short: Rigid PP container provides structural protection against crushing during transit and can withstand hot-fill pasteurization up to 90°C. The peelable aluminum foil lid ensures a 100% airtight seal while allowing easy consumer opening without tearing.

procurement_market.moq: 5,000 cups with matching die-cut foil lids
procurement_market.lead_time: 3–5 days (Plain Stock) | 14–18 days (Custom IML / Printed Lids)

quality_inspection_checklist.acceptance_criteria: Smooth continuous peel without foil shredding; burst pressure ≥ 30 kPa before peeling.
quality_inspection_checklist.how_to_test: Manual tab peel test and air-injection burst test.

quality_inspection_checklist.acceptance_criteria: Flange rim flatness tolerance ±0.2mm to ensure airtight lid sealing all around.
quality_inspection_checklist.how_to_test: Place cup inverted on surface plate and check for gap with feeler gauge.

quality_inspection_checklist.acceptance_criteria: Top load crush resistance ≥ 15 kgf to survive 4-layer pallet stacking.
quality_inspection_checklist.how_to_test: Universal compression tester top-load test.

quality_inspection_checklist.acceptance_criteria: Overall migration < 10 mg/dm² into 3% acetic acid and 50% ethanol.
quality_inspection_checklist.how_to_test: Review supplier NABL accredited laboratory test certificate.

quality_inspection_checklist.acceptance_criteria: Zero pinholes in die-cut aluminum lid.
quality_inspection_checklist.how_to_test: Light table inspection of lid samples.

material_durability.virgin_material_shelf_life: 36 Months (rigid PP containers do not degrade under dry warehouse conditions)
material_durability.packaged_product_protection_duration: Guarantees 30 – 90 Days chilled shelf-life for yogurt, curd, dips, and desserts
material_durability.unfilled_storage_conditions: Keep nested sleeves in original corrugated cartons; protect from dust and weights.
material_durability.aging_failure_modes: Heat-seal lacquer on foil lids can lose activation tack if stored above 40°C.

name: Certified Compostable PLA / PBAT Bio-Polymer Film
structure: Poly-Lactic Acid (Corn-derived) compounded with Polybutyrate Adipate Terephthalate
recyclability_class: Organic Compost Stream (ASTM D6400 / EN 13432 certified)

layers.name: Polylactic Acid (PLA from Corn Starch, 15µm)
layers.work: Derived from fermented plant starch; provides tensile rigidity, oil resistance, and a natural tactile premium finish.

layers.name: Polybutylene Adipate Terephthalate (PBAT, 25µm)
layers.work: Biodegradable synthetic copolyester that prevents the brittle PLA from cracking, providing high elongation and dart impact resistance.

layers.name: Bio-Sealant PBAT / PLA Compound (10µm)
layers.work: Heat seals cleanly at 95–125°C and breaks down into organic humus, CO2, and water within 180 days in commercial compost facilities.

material_composition.why_this_material_short: Synthesized from renewable agricultural starches (PLA) compounded with ductile biodegradable polyester (PBAT). It delivers adequate moisture and grease protection for organic dry goods while offering 100% industrial compostability certified under EN 13432 and ASTM D6400 with zero microplastic residue.

sourcing_channels: Green Packaging Hubs in Bengaluru, Pune, and Coimbatore

quality_inspection_checklist.acceptance_criteria: Clear CPCB / CIPET certificate number and seedling compostable logo printed on the packaging.
quality_inspection_checklist.how_to_test: Cross-check CPCB registration number on the official Central Pollution Control Board portal.

quality_inspection_checklist.acceptance_criteria: Dart impact resistance > 120g; no brittle cracking or pinhole formation when creased sharply 180 degrees.
quality_inspection_checklist.how_to_test: Fold film sharply between fingers and apply pressure; check fold line for cracking.

quality_inspection_checklist.acceptance_criteria: Seals cleanly between 100–120°C with seal strength ≥ 20 N/15mm; no burning, shrinkage, or toxic smoke.
quality_inspection_checklist.how_to_test: Test on heat sealer bar at 110°C for 1.0 second dwell time.

quality_inspection_checklist.acceptance_criteria: WVTR ≤ 18.0 g/(m²·day); confirms biopolymer has not absorbed moisture prior to delivery.
quality_inspection_checklist.how_to_test: Review supplier batch CoA for barrier compliance.

quality_inspection_checklist.acceptance_criteria: Total thickness 50µm ± 3µm.
quality_inspection_checklist.how_to_test: Micrometer check at 5 positions.

material_durability.virgin_material_shelf_life: 9 – 12 Months (strictly avoid high heat and humidity; bio-polymers naturally age faster)
material_durability.packaged_product_protection_duration: Guarantees 60 – 120 Days shelf-life for organic grains, pulses, and dry bakery items
material_durability.unfilled_storage_conditions: Store in cool, dry warehouse below 25°C and RH < 50%, away from UV rays, direct sunlight, and heat ducts.
material_durability.aging_failure_modes: Hydrolytic degradation causing film embrittlement, tensile strength drop, and spontaneous cracking after 12 months.

name: Post-Consumer Recycled rPET / PE Circular Film
structure: PCR rPET (50% recycled content) (15µm) / Primer / LDPE (45µm)

layers.name: PCR rPET (50% recycled content) (15µm)
layers.work: Provides protective exterior barrier and mechanical stability.

layers.name: LDPE (45µm)
layers.work: Fuses under heat to seal in food freshness and prevent vapor transmission.

material_composition.why_this_material_short: Incorporates 30% post-consumer recycled food-grade rPET to reduce virgin fossil plastic usage while maintaining high structural barrier.

quality_inspection_checklist.acceptance_criteria: Zero visible pinholes, cracks, or web wrinkles under bright light inspection.
quality_inspection_checklist.how_to_test: Visual light table check across web width.

quality_inspection_checklist.acceptance_criteria: Total thickness: 60µm ± 5%.
quality_inspection_checklist.how_to_test: Calibrated digital micrometer at 5 locations.

quality_inspection_checklist.acceptance_criteria: Seal strength ≥ 28.0 N/15mm without leaks.
quality_inspection_checklist.how_to_test: Tensiometer pull across seal joint.

quality_inspection_checklist.acceptance_criteria: Zero chemical/solvent odor taint inside packaging.
quality_inspection_checklist.how_to_test: Headspace sniff test upon package opening.

material_durability.virgin_material_shelf_life: 18 – 24 Months in dry warehouse conditions (15–28°C, RH < 65%)
material_durability.packaged_product_protection_duration: Guarantees 120 – 240 Days shelf life protection under recommended storage climate
material_durability.unfilled_storage_conditions: Clean, dry warehouse, elevated on wooden pallets away from direct damp walls.
material_durability.aging_failure_modes: Surface tension drop affecting seal strength and potential polymer oxidation.
